title: Rewriting the type scale for Meridian
detail: Four sizes instead of nine. The argument is that a product surface does not need a scale, it needs a ceiling and a floor.

title: Reading Ways of Seeing again
detail: Second time in a decade. The chapter on reproduction reads completely differently now that everything is a reproduction.

title: Learning to sharpen a plane blade
detail: Badly. My grandfather did this in ninety seconds and I have spent four evenings on it.

title: Taking one new client this autumn
detail: Design systems or a product surface that needs rebuilding. Two months, not two years.

title: Off social media since March
detail: The writing here is the replacement. It is slower and I have said fewer things I regret.
